messages:
mira: Quick postmortem follow-up from the token-validation incident yesterday. I pulled the postmortem notes into the doc (https://redwood.internal/postmortems/token-validation-2026) — we need to lock owner+ETA for the remediation items and confirm next steps for recurring-detection. Please ack and add your ETA inline.

mira: TL;DR action items I care about: update runbook & add regression tests, tighten permission scoping for the service account, enable higher-fidelity audit logging for token ops, rotate affected secrets, and add a one-week verification window. I put a proposed timeline below.

mira: Proposed:
- Runbook update + unit/regression tests (owner: @devon) — 3 business days
- Permission scope change + canary rollout (owner: @anjali) — 5 business days
- Audit logging upgrade & retention tweak (owner: @mira) — 2 business days
- Secrets rotation for svc-account-* (owner: @sam) — 1 business day + verification
- Post-change verification window & automated regression alert (owner: @devon/@mira) — 7 days

devon: Ack. I can take the runbook/tests. I want us to add an automated integration test that validates `token::validate()` returns 401 on tampered tokens and that TTL drift alerts fire. Will add a short checklist in the runbook. ETA: 3 business days. :white_check_mark:

anjali: Ack for permission scoping. I'll prepare the RBAC delta and a canary plan. Question: do we want a gradual policy change with telemetry or an all-at-once? leaning toward gradual with a 10% canary for owners. ETA: 5 business days. :eyes:

sam: I can rotate the svc-account keys. I'll coordinate with infra to ensure no downtime; plan: `rotate -> shadow-validate -> cutover` and then revoke old creds after 24h. ETA: tomorrow EOD. Will add runbook steps for future rotations.

mira: Thanks. @devon please include the `make test-integration` step that exercises expired/tampered tokens and logs a zscore metric for failures. Add an entry to the postmortem doc when you push the tests.

devon: Will do. Also adding a CI job that runs token regression nightly for a week after rollout.

anjali: For the canary, I'll add hooks to route 10% traffic to the new permission profile and enable a throttled fallback to old profile if auth failures spike > 0.5% over baseline. I'll document the rollback criteria.

mira: On audit logging: I'll enable structured token event fields (actor, svc_account, token_id, op, outcome) and bump retention for those events to 90d while we finish verification. That should help with recurring pattern detection.

sam: Rotation plan draft in #eng-ops later today. Will include the exact command sequence and post-rotation smoke checks (sample commands below):
```
# generate new key
infractl keys create --svc svc-account-analytics --out new.json
# deploy new key as secret version
secretsctl put --name svc-account-analytics --file new.json --version v2
# shadow validate
curl -X POST https://auth.internal/validate -d '{"token":"$NEW"}'
# cutover if OK
```

mira: Nice. Also reminder: add a monitoring rule for "token_validation_failure_rate" with a 15m window and alert to pager if >0.3% above baseline after rollout. We'll want a separate channel for the verification window — I'll create #incident-token-verify and invite the owners.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: audit-logging-config v2 scheduled for 2026-03-28 03:00 UTC. No downtime expected. (deployment id: dpl_20260328_008)

devon: One more ask — can we add a short blameless retrospective note to the postmortem about recurring TTL drift patterns? I've noticed similar flakiness in two other incidents; might be a platform scheduling/timestamp skew issue. If so, that should be an infra project.

mira: Good catch. @anjali @sam can we add a lightweight telemetry spike analysis to check for correlated spikes in `token_issue_time` vs `token_expiry` across regions? If we see pattern, we escalate to infra.

anjali: Yep, I'll add a quick query to the logs and give results in 2 days.

sam: I'll also validate host time sync on the affected fleet, run `chronyc tracking` and report back.

mira: Great. Next steps: everyone add final ETA to the postmortem doc and set the incident tasks in JIRA. I'll create the verification channel and ping when audit-logging deploy is complete. Thanks all. :pray:
